title: Tore apart in 3 minutes.
text: Tore apart in 3 minutes.. Literally had this on my door less than three minutes when the string that supposed to tie on the door knob ripped off. The material feels rough and cheap and it is obviously not made well. There are so many of these for sale that I would definitely suggest buying a different one. This one looks like it came from dollar tree.
